title: 50 Days, alot of Opus 5.5 and alot of confussion as first time Dev
author: Educational-Smoke-88
selftext:
I would appreciate any feedback!  
So i started this Project 50 days ago and I am pretty happy with the Progress I added alot of different content in the last 30 days. 



Basically my game is about: Cleaning Service in a town where the trash came to life in a Comic Style Look. You fight it, clean the apartment, recycle the trash, buy new yards/machinery/cars and sell it. I am pretty confused on many concepts like GameFeel and Juice. As i just dont get how to make it feel better, also is it nomal that i cant judge the feel anymore because ive played it and seen it so often? 

You can also check out my yt page, I use it for getting reach while setting up my steam page, I would also appreciate any feedback there!! [https://www.youtube.com/@NeedToCleanGame](https://www.youtube.com/@NeedToCleanGame)
